name: comp-433

frames.best_why: Shows the whole tab bar with the first tab active and its matching caption underneath.

tagline: A dark pill tab bar whose icons sit beside count and New badges.
summary: Three icon-and-label tabs in a dark rounded bar, two carrying badge pills reading 3 and New; the active tab shifts onto a lighter block and swaps the caption below.
appearance: A charcoal rounded strip holds three tabs, each a small line icon, a label, and where present a pale pill badge reading 3 or New. The chosen tab sits on a lighter grey rounded block, with one muted sentence centred below the bar.
behaviour: Clicking a tab slides the lighter highlight onto it and replaces the caption beneath with that tab's line. Badges on inactive tabs dim to half opacity; the bar itself does not move.
demo_content: Tabs Overview, Projects, Packages; badges 3 and New; captions about members, progress and a UI package release.
search_phrases: switch between sections in a bar
menu of views with new label
click to swap content below tabs
use_when: Switching between a few related views in one compact area while keeping counts visible per view.
avoid_when: When labels and panel text must come from data: every tab and caption is written into the file.
customise: Tab names, icons, badge values and each panel caption are written inside; changing them means editing the file. Badge opacity and spacing are classes.
weight_why: Three tabs and a few small badges; only opacity and highlight transitions run.

a11y.note: Tabs are real labelled controls with hidden icons, so screen readers get clean names; no reduced-motion handling.

polish_why: Tidy dark tabs with neat badge placement, but otherwise a standard segmented control.
